newsitem.title: USA: E-data settles with one in patent suit.
newsitem.headline: E-data settles with one in patent suit.

text.p: E-data Corp said Wednesday it settled with one of the defendants in the patent infringement suits brought by E-data in New York and Connecticut courts.

Privately-held CyberSource Corp of Menlo Park, Calif., settled with E-data and took out a license for the company's Internet software relating to point-of-sale transactions, E-data said. The statement did not disclose the terms and conditions of the settlement.

There are 12 defendants remaining in the case before the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York and eight in the case before the U.S. District Court for District of Connecticut, according to the statement.
"It's a landmark case for the validity of Internet patents," an E-data spokesman said. "The whole industry is watching."

As a next step in the proceedings, a judge will narrow the scope of E-data's claims, the spokesman said, adding a date for the hearing had not yet been set. After that, the case goes to trial, he said.
"The company is well-financed and intends to go the whole way," he said.
